# Data format

<!-- generated by `python -m healthaio schema --markdown`; edit healthaio/schema.py instead -->

All tables are UTF-8 CSV files with a header row, kept in the data directory
named in ``healthaio.toml``. Importers write them; modules only read them.
``docs/DATA_FORMAT.md`` is generated from this file (``python -m healthaio schema --markdown``).

Conventions
- ``date``: local calendar day, ``YYYY-MM-DD``.
- ``datetime``: local wall-clock time without offset, ``YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`` (seconds optional).
  The timezone is the one in ``healthaio.toml``. One exception: ``sleep_start`` / ``sleep_end`` from
  Apple Health are in the zone you slept in, so a night abroad reads as you lived it.
- Minutes are real minutes: on the day clocks go forward the skipped hour is not counted, and a
  record that runs through the repeated hour when they go back counts it twice (23- and 25-hour days).
- Empty cell = unknown. Unknown is never read as zero.
- A sleep belongs to the day you woke up.

## `body_daily.csv`

One row per day of body measurements, usually from a watch or phone.

Key: `date`. Typical sources: Apple Health export (healthaio import apple-health); any CSV with these columns.

| column | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | date | yes | The day. Sleep is filed under the day you woke up. |
| `sleep_min` | number |  | Minutes asleep in the main sleep that ended this day. |
| `in_bed_min` | number |  | Minutes in bed for the same sleep. |
| `sleep_start` | datetime |  | When you fell asleep (local time). |
| `sleep_end` | datetime |  | When you woke up (local time). |
| `hrv_ms` | number |  | Heart-rate variability (SDNN or RMSSD, but keep one kind), ms. |
| `resting_hr` | number |  | Resting heart rate, beats per minute. |
| `steps` | number |  | Steps that day. |
| `exercise_min` | number |  | Minutes of exercise (Apple 'Exercise' ring or similar). |
| `workout_min` | number |  | Minutes of logged workouts. 0 means rest day; empty means unknown. |
| `workout_type` | text |  | Main workout that day, free text (e.g. strength, run). |
| `active_kcal` | number |  | Active energy burned that day, kcal (Apple's Move ring). |
| `basal_kcal` | number |  | Resting energy that day, kcal (what the body burns at rest). |
| `weight_kg` | number |  | Body weight, kg. |
| `waist_cm` | number |  | Waist, cm. |
| `complete` | flag |  | 1 if the day was over when the data was exported; 0 if the export happened mid-day (then steps and minutes are not compared with your normal). |

## `workouts.csv`

Each workout with its start and end, e.g. from Apple Fitness or a watch. The day ring and Review use the times; body_daily.workout_min is the daily total. A workout paused along the way can be one row per stretch of moving (the Apple Health importer writes it so), so the minutes are the time spent moving. `end` must be after `start`.

Key: `start`, `type`. Typical sources: Apple Health export, which includes Apple Fitness and Workout app sessions (healthaio import apple-health); Strava, Garmin or any CSV with these columns.

| column | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | datetime | yes | Start (local time). |
| `end` | datetime | yes | End (local time). |
| `type` | text | yes | What kind of workout, e.g. strength training, running. |
| `source` | text |  | Which app or device recorded it. |
| `kcal` | number |  | Active energy for the workout, kcal. |
| `avg_hr` | number |  | Average heart rate during the workout, beats per minute. |
| `effort` | number |  | How hard it was, 1 (easy) to 10 (all out): your own rating in the Fitness or Workout app, otherwise the watch's estimate. On every row of a paused workout. |
| `effort_source` | text |  | Whose number the effort is: rated by you, or estimated by the watch. One of: `rated`, `estimated`. |

## `meals.csv`

What you ate, one row per meal or snack, e.g. from a food-logging app that writes to Apple Health. A day with no rows was not logged: it is unknown, never zero calories. A day counts as logged once it has at least two main meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner); with fewer it is shown but not averaged. A meal before 4 am counts for the day before; a time of exactly 00:00 is read as a date without a time (what a date-only export gives) and counts for its own day.

Key: `time`, `meal`. Typical sources: Apple Health export, which holds what MyFitnessPal, Lose It!, Cronometer and similar apps write there (healthaio import apple-health); a food app's CSV export (healthaio import csv meals).

| column | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | datetime | yes | When you started eating (local time). |
| `meal` | text | yes | Which meal it was. One of: `breakfast`, `lunch`, `dinner`, `snack`, `drink`. |
| `title` | text |  | What it was, in your own words. |
| `kcal` | number |  | Energy, kcal. |
| `protein_g` | number |  | Protein, grams. |
| `carbs_g` | number |  | Carbohydrate, grams. |
| `fat_g` | number |  | Fat, grams. |
| `fiber_g` | number |  | Fibre, grams. |
| `source` | text |  | Which app it came from. |

## `self_report.csv`

How you said you felt. Optional; pages show a prompt when it is empty. `feel` is the Recovery page's morning check-in; energy and focus are typed by hand or written by an assistant.

Key: `date`. Typical sources: typed by hand; an assistant that writes this file for you.

| column | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | date | yes | The day. |
| `energy` | number |  | Body energy, 0 (drained) to 5 (full). |
| `focus` | number |  | Mental focus, 0 to 5. |
| `note` | text |  | One line in your own words. |
| `feel` | number |  | This morning, in one of three answers: 2 not recovered, 5 so-so, 8 recovered (the Recovery page writes it). |

## `soreness.csv`

Where you were sore in the morning and how much: one row per sore region, or a single row with region `none` when you checked in and nothing was sore. A day without rows was not checked: unknown, never "not sore". The Recovery page's morning check-in writes this file; you can also write it by hand or import a CSV.

Key: `date`, `region`. Typical sources: the Recovery page's body figure; typed by hand; any CSV with these columns.

| column | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | date | yes | The morning. |
| `region` | text | yes | Which region (the body figure's seven), or none. One of: `head`, `torso`, `pelvis`, `left_upper_arm`, `right_upper_arm`, `left_calf`, `right_calf`, `none`. |
| `level` | number | yes | 1 a little, 2 clearly sore, 3 very sore; 0 with region none. |

## `screen_sessions.csv`

Foreground app sessions across your devices. Overlaps between devices are allowed; Health AIO counts wall-clock time once, preferring the device order in healthaio.toml (the Stimulation page's devices-at-once tab counts each device on its own). `end` must be after `start`.

Key: `start`, `device`, `app`. Typical sources: macOS Screen Time / Biome (healthaio import macos-screentime); RescueTime or ActivityWatch CSV; any CSV with these columns.

| column | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | datetime | yes | Session start (local time). |
| `end` | datetime | yes | Session end (local time). |
| `device` | text | yes | Device name, e.g. laptop, phone, tablet. |
| `app` | text | yes | App name or website domain. |
| `category` | text | yes | What kind of use it was. One of: `work`, `learning`, `communication`, `entertainment`, `social`, `other`. |

## `events.csv`

Calendar blocks: classes, work shifts, planned training.

Key: `start`, `title`. Typical sources: any .ics calendar (healthaio import ics); any CSV with these columns.

| column | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | datetime | yes | Start (local time). |
| `end` | datetime | yes | End (local time). |
| `title` | text | yes | What it is. |
| `kind` | text | yes | Type of block. One of: `class`, `work`, `training`, `personal`, `other`. |
| `location` | text |  | Where. |

## `deadlines.csv`

Things due on a date: assignments, exams, milestones.

Key: `due`, `title`. Typical sources: typed by hand; a course or project tracker export.

| column | type | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `due` | datetime | yes | When it is due (local time). Use 23:59 if only the day is known. |
| `title` | text | yes | What is due. |
| `group` | text |  | Course or project it belongs to. |
| `weight_pct` | number |  | Share of the course grade, percent. Empty if it is not graded. |
| `status` | text |  | Where it stands. One of: `todo`, `submitted`, `done`. |
| `note` | text |  | Format, length, group size, anything you want to see next to it. |
